snippet.title: Gum Squad - Teaser
snippet.description:
I've been quietly cooking up this one for a while. The game releases on 02/27/2026!!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4231020/Gum_Squad/
Watch a video about the development process here: https://youtu.be/oL8W-7iNnq4

Gum Squad is a co-op PvE shooter set in a quiet world gone sticky. Start with a peashooter, explore together, and gear up to survive the gum epidemic with up to 8 players!
